author: sweeeper
body:
I'm thinking of making another map, so I'm wondering, which game mode is in most need of new maps?

Avicade, DTM, TDM, Nexus, CTH or Walls?

:)

title: Which gamemode?

replies.author: sweeeper
replies.body: I'd love to build another nebula map, but don't you think there's quite a few made already?

replies.body: Avicade is in need of more maps.

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body: I would say CTH or Walls. I want to see really pretty maps from  you in the rots :D

replies.author: Arachadonic
replies.body: Nebula is fairly saturated with maps. I'd go with Nexus/Walls. I personally wouldnt make anything for avicade since like no one plays that anyway.

replies.author: sweeeper
replies.body:
Okey guys, thank you all for the feedback! I've come to the decision to make a walls map. I will also build something for Nebula but my main priority will be the walls map.

(\ ^_^)/
